summary: o-0050695b3e3ec3e5 (g0001): the old harness has a preexisting gap in raw array-element printing.

claims.necessity_reason: Printing an array containing a cJSON_Raw child is supported on both sides. A finite setup can create a raw item and insert it into an array, but the old harness prints only parsed trees. Parsing cannot produce a raw child, and the harness has no construction route.

before.requirement: Reach printing of an array containing a cJSON_Raw child.
before.reason: The array printer passes each child to print_value, which supports cJSON_Raw. Array parsing obtains children through parse_value, which has no raw case. The old harness uses only that parsing route.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: print_value supports emitting a raw child.
Array parsing obtains each child through parse_value.
The complete value dispatcher has no cJSON_Raw case.
The public constructor can create the supported raw item.
The public API provides an insertion route for the raw item.

after.requirement: Reach printing of an array containing a cJSON_Raw child.
after.reason: The new depth guard still permits a shallow array with a raw child. Raw printing remains supported, while the unchanged old harness still obtains trees only through parsing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: print_value still supports emitting a raw child.
Array parsing still obtains each child through parse_value.
The complete value dispatcher still has no cJSON_Raw case.
The public raw constructor remains available.
The public array insertion API remains available.

claims.comparison_reason: On both sides, the same parse-only tree setup prevents a cJSON_Raw array child from reaching printing.
